summary: Idira Secrets Manager, Self-Hosted (formerly CyberArk Conjur Enterprise): secrets management in your own infrastructure for on-premises and isolated environments.
value: Passwords and tokens are removed from code, pipelines and configs.
A program gets a secret only after proving what it is.
Everything stays in your own infrastructure.
simple: Secrets management deployed on your own infrastructure — for on-premises and isolated environments (formerly CyberArk Conjur Enterprise, DAP). Applications, CI/CD pipelines, containers and automation tools receive passwords, tokens and keys from the vault at run time, proving themselves by their own attributes, so secrets are not stored in code or configuration. Secrets rotate automatically, and access follows policies with audit; it scales as a highly available cluster. A free open-source version is Idira Conjur. Licensed in machine secrets packs.
